title: Impl: DAO storm window in Python ForwardingBuffer
description: Add storm_until timestamp to ForwardingBuffer. On parent_changed event, set storm_until=now+5.0s. In try_buffer(), if now < storm_until, use per_source_limit=4. File: python/src/lichen/link/forwarding_buffer.py. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_forward*.py -x
